items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face address security incident during model evaluation
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 联合披露了一起在模型评估过程中发现的安全事件，涉及潜在的数据泄露风险。两家公司迅速响应，修补了漏洞并加强了评估流程的防护措施。这一事件突显了 AI 模型评估环节的安全性不容忽视，特别是在第三方协作和开放测试环境中，更需要建立严格的安全审查机制。
items.summary_en: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed a security incident that occurred during a model evaluation, involving potential data exposure risks. Both companies responded quickly, patching the vulnerability and reinforcing security protocols in the evaluation pipeline. This incident highlights that AI model evaluation stages are not immune to attacks, especially in collaborative and open-testing environments, underscoring the need for rigorous security review processes to protect sensitive data.

items.title: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.author: dwwoelfel
items.summary_zh: 最新的神经科学研究再次证实，手写比打字更能激活大脑中负责学习和记忆的区域。当人们用笔在纸上写字时，手部精细动作与视觉、空间感知的协同作用能加深对信息的处理，从而提升理解和长期记忆。对于学生、创意工作者以及任何希望提高学习效率的人来说，暂时放下键盘、拿起纸笔可能是一种简单而有效的认知训练。
items.summary_en: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. For students, creatives, and anyone seeking to learn more effectively, this suggests that swapping the keyboard for a notebook now and then is a simple yet powerful cognitive boost.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.author: alvis
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是Anthropic最新发布的大型语言模型，据称在推理、代码生成和多轮对话能力上实现了显著飞跃。相比前代，它更擅长处理长上下文和复杂指令，同时保持了较高的安全性。对于需要强大AI助手进行编程、写作及分析的开发者与研究者来说，这代表了一项重要的生产力提升工具。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest large language model, boasting major improvements in reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. It handles longer contexts and complex instructions more adeptly while maintaining strong safety guardrails. For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

items.title: Terence Tao's ChatGPT conversation about the Jacobian Conjecture counterexample
items.author: gmays
items.summary_zh: 数学界著名的陶哲轩最近分享了他与 ChatGPT 关于雅可比猜想反例的对话记录。这不仅仅是技术演示，更展示了大型语言模型如何辅助顶尖数学家进行前沿研究。ChatGPT 帮助他梳理思路、验证推理过程，甚至可能提出新的视角。对于数学爱好者和 AI 研究者来说，这是一个绝佳的案例，说明 AI 正从计算工具进化为真正的科研伙伴。
items.summary_en: Renowned mathematician Terrence Tao recently shared his conversation with ChatGPT about a potential counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture. This is more than a tech demo—it shows how large language models can assist top-tier researchers in cutting-edge mathematics. ChatGPT helped him organize thoughts, verify reasoning, and perhaps even suggest new angles. For math enthusiasts and AI researchers, it's a compelling case study of AI evolving from a calculator into a genuine research collaborator.

items.title: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
items.author: theanonymousone
items.summary_zh: 一群创业公司的创始人联合向美国政府发出呼吁，请求不要切断中国开源AI模型的访问渠道。他们认为，中国团队开发的开放权重模型（如Qwen、Llama的中国衍生版）为全球AI生态注入了竞争与多样性，阻断它们将损害技术创新，并迫使全球开发者依赖少数封闭平台。这一呼声凸显了AI开源社区对地缘政治干预的真实忧虑。
items.summary_en: A group of startup founders has urged the U.S. government not to block access to Chinese open-weight AI models, arguing that models like Qwen and derivative Llama variants contribute crucial competition and diversity to the global AI ecosystem. They warn that cutting off these models would stifle innovation and force developers towards a handful of closed platforms. The plea underscores growing anxiety within the open-source community over geopolitical tensions threatening cross-border AI collaboration.

items.title: Show HN: Bento - An entire PowerPoint in one HTML file (edit+view+data+collab)
items.author: starfallg
items.summary_zh: Bento 是一个有趣的项目，让你把一整个 PowerPoint 演示文稿塞进一个 HTML 文件里。它不仅支持编辑和查看，还内置了数据处理和协作功能。这意味着你再也不用担心格式错乱或软件兼容性问题，分享起来就像发一个网页链接一样简单。对于经常做演示、尤其是技术团队来说，这简直是效率神器。
items.summary_en: Bento is a neat project that lets you pack an entire PowerPoint presentation into a single HTML file. It supports editing, viewing, data handling, and collaboration all within that one file. The beauty is that you never have to worry about formatting issues or software compatibility again—sharing a presentation becomes as simple as sending a link. For anyone who frequently creates and shares slides, especially in technical teams, this is a huge productivity boost.

items.title: It's getting harder to focus every day
items.author: peykar
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了现代人越来越难以集中注意力的现象，分析了社交媒体无休止推送、碎片化信息过载以及多任务工作文化对大脑专注力的侵蚀。作者指出，这不仅是个人自律问题，更是数字环境设计导致的系统性困境，并呼吁重新审视工作工具和日常习惯以保护深度思考能力。
items.summary_en: This piece dives into the growing struggle to maintain focus in a distraction-saturated world. It blames endless social media feeds, information overload, and multitasking culture for eroding our attention spans. More than a personal willpower issue, the author argues it's a systemic problem of digital environment design, urging a rethink of tools and habits to preserve deep thinking.

items.title: AI Companies Are Trying to Hide a Staggering Amount of Debt
items.author: technewssss
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章揭露了AI公司看似风光背后隐藏的巨额债务问题，包括未披露的硬件采购欠款、数据中心建设贷款以及人才薪资泡沫。随着融资环境收紧，这种隐性负债可能成为压垮许多初创公司的隐患。它警示投资者和从业者，不应只关注模型能力，还要审视公司真正的财务健康度。
items.summary_en: This article shines a light on the staggering hidden debts AI companies are carrying—undisclosed hardware procurement bills, data center construction loans, and inflated talent costs. As funding tightens, these liabilities could become ticking time bombs for startups. It's a stark reminder for investors and practitioners to look beyond model benchmarks and examine financial health.

items.title: Are AI labs pelicanmaxxing?
items.author: dcastm
items.summary_zh: “Pelicanmaxxing”是网络流行语，形容AI实验室像鹈鹕一样疯狂往嘴里塞鱼——即不计成本地堆积算力、数据和参数，追求所谓“更大就是更好”。文章调侃这种极端优化行为可能导致训练浪费、碳足迹激增与边际效益递减，引发对当前大模型发展路线是否可持续的反思。
items.summary_en: “Pelicanmaxxing” is a playful term describing AI labs frantically gobbling up compute, data, and parameters like pelicans, chasing the “bigger is better” ideal. This article humorously critiques such extreme optimization for resulting in wasteful training, soaring carbon footprints, and diminishing returns. It sparks a necessary debate on whether the current scaling paradigm is truly sustainable.

items.title: Everyone should know SIMD
items.author: WadeGrimridge
items.summary_zh: SIMD（单指令多数据）是一种并行计算技术，让一条指令同时处理多个数据，能大幅提升性能。现代CPU普遍支持SIMD指令集，但许多开发者对此知之甚少。这篇文章呼吁每位程序员都应该了解SIMD，尤其是在处理音视频、科学计算和游戏等场景时，掌握SIMD可以带来显著的性能优化。对追求极致性能的开发者而言，SIMD是不容忽视的核心技能。
items.summary_en: SIMD, or Single Instruction Multiple Data, is a parallel computing technique that allows a single instruction to operate on multiple data points simultaneously, dramatically improving performance. Modern CPUs all come with SIMD instruction sets, yet many developers overlook them. This piece argues that every programmer should understand SIMD, especially those working on multimedia processing, scientific computing, or game development. Learning SIMD can unlock significant performance gains for compute-intensive tasks, making it an essential skill for anyone serious about optimization.

items.title: If coding has been solved, why does software keep getting worse?
items.author: pchm
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章挑战了“AI已经解决了编程问题”的流行叙事，反问：如果编码真的被“解决”了，为什么软件质量反而越来越差？作者指出，AI代码助手虽然能快速生成大量代码，但缺乏对软件架构、可维护性和长期可靠性的理解，导致技术债务积累。而且，糟糕的需求和设计决策才是软件变坏的根源，而这些靠自动补全根本无法解决。对于开发者而言，这提醒我们不要盲目迷信AI，而应坚持良好的工程实践。
items.summary_en: This article pushes back against the claim that AI has solved coding, asking why software keeps getting worse if that were true. The author argues that AI code assistants generate plenty of code quickly but lack understanding of architecture, maintainability, and long-term reliability, leading to technical debt. Worse, bad requirements and design decisions — not the act of writing code — are the real cause of software degradation, and autocomplete won't fix that. Developers are reminded to not blindly trust AI and to uphold good engineering practices.

items.title: My security camera shipped a GitHub admin token in its login page
items.author: hhh
items.summary_zh: 一名用户发现其购买的安防摄像头在登录页面的HTML源码中硬编码了一个GitHub管理员的访问令牌。这意味着任何能查看页面源码的人都有可能直接接管与该令牌关联的GitHub账户。这一事件揭示了物联网设备在供应链安全和固件开发流程中的严重漏洞，敲响了智能家居设备厂商必须加强安全审计的警钟。
items.summary_en: A user discovered that their security camera had a GitHub admin access token hard-coded in the login page's HTML source code, meaning anyone who could view the page source potentially had the ability to take over the associated GitHub account. This incident highlights a severe supply chain and firmware development flaw in IoT devices, serving as a stark warning for smart home manufacturers to ramp up security audits and avoid shipping such dangerous credentials.

items.title: I regret migrating to Codeberg
items.author: boramalper
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者发文表示后悔将项目从GitHub迁移到Codeberg，列举了迁移后面临的诸多问题，包括平台性能不稳定、社区活跃度低、与现有工具的集成不便等。尽管Codeberg作为去中心化、开源的Git托管平台理念很好，但实际使用体验却未能满足日常协作需求。这个故事给那些考虑离开大型平台、拥抱完全开源解决方案的用户提供了一个值得深思的真实案例。
items.summary_en: A developer shared their regret over migrating a project from GitHub to Codeberg, citing issues like unstable platform performance, low community engagement, and poor integration with existing tools. While Codeberg's philosophy as a decentralized, open-source Git hosting platform is appealing, the real-world experience fell short of expectations for day-to-day collaboration. This cautionary tale offers valuable lessons for anyone considering moving away from major platforms in favor of fully open alternatives.

Built by Skyroot Aerospace and named Vikram-S, the rocket demonstrated low-cost, responsive launch capabilities, boosting confidence in India's commercial space sector. For space enthusiasts and satellite operators, this means a new reliable option for deploying small satellites quickly and affordably, potentially reshaping the global launch market.

It assists quantitative trading, risk management, and investment research. For quantitative analysts and institutional investors, Kronos promises to be a powerful tool for interpreting market signals and generating trading strategies.

items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

items.title: Fedica 2.0
items.description: Publish and grow your profile across social apps
items.summary_zh: Fedica 2.0是一款跨社交平台的内容发布和账号增长工具，支持在多个社交应用上统一管理和定时发布内容，同时提供数据分析来帮助用户扩大影响力。对于社交媒体运营者、品牌营销人员以及个人创作者来说，它简化了多平台维护的繁琐流程，让你可以更专注于内容本身。新版本可能加入了更智能的排程和增长建议，是提升社交效率的得力助手。
items.summary_en: Fedica 2.0 is a cross-platform social media tool designed to help users publish and grow their profiles across various social apps. It centralizes content scheduling, posting, and analytics, making it easier for social media managers, marketers, and creators to maintain a consistent presence. The update promises smarter scheduling and growth insights, solving the pain point of managing multiple accounts. By streamlining workflows and providing actionable data, Fedica 2.0 helps users save time and build a larger, more engaged audience.

items.title: Pushary
items.description: Approve AI requests from your lock screen
items.summary_zh: Pushary是一款创新的工具，让你直接从手机锁屏上批准AI发出的请求，无需解锁设备。这种设计大幅提升了效率，特别适合那些频繁需要授权AI代理访问数据或执行操作的场景，比如自动化工作流或智能家居控制。对于依赖AI助手的用户来说，Pushary简化了交互流程，将审批过程变得像查看通知一样快速便捷，既安全又省时。
items.summary_en: Pushary is an innovative app that lets you approve AI requests directly from your lock screen without unlocking your phone. It streamlines the interaction with AI agents, allowing for quick authorization of actions like data access or task execution. This is especially useful for users who rely on automated workflows or smart home controls, where fast approvals are needed. By turning the approval process into a simple lock-screen notification, Pushary enhances both security and efficiency, making AI interactions feel more natural and less intrusive.

items.title: Fluree AI
items.description: Give every AI agent trusted context
items.summary_zh: Fluree AI致力于为每个AI代理提供可信的上下文数据，确保人工智能决策基于可靠和经过验证的信息源。在AI应用日益普及的今天，模型幻觉和错误数据是主要痛点。Fluree AI通过构建可信的数据基础，帮助开发者在构建智能代理时减少虚构信息，提升回答的准确性。对于企业级AI部署而言，它提供了一种机制来保证AI输出的可信度，特别适合金融、医疗等对数据准确性要求极高的领域。
items.summary_en: Fluree AI aims to give every AI agent trusted context by providing a reliable and verifiable data foundation. As AI agents become more common, ensuring they base their decisions on accurate information is crucial to avoiding hallucinations and errors. Fluree AI solves this by integrating trusted data sources directly into the AI pipeline, allowing developers to build agents that produce more trustworthy outputs. This is particularly valuable for enterprise applications in finance, healthcare, and legal sectors where data integrity is paramount. By grounding AI in verified context, Fluree AI enhances reliability and reduces risk.

items.title: The new Firecrawl /search
items.description: Our most accurate Search API for AI agents.
items.summary_zh: Firecrawl推出的全新/search API专为AI代理打造，号称目前最精准的网页搜索接口，能从互联网中提取结构化数据并返回可靠结果。它解决了AI应用在实时信息获取时常见的噪声和不可靠性问题，对构建智能助手和自动化工具的开发者至关重要。
items.summary_en: The new Firecrawl /search API is designed specifically for AI agents, offering what is claimed to be the most accurate search endpoint available. It extracts structured data from the web and returns clean, reliable results, solving the issues of noise and unreliability that often plague AI applications needing real-time information. This makes it essential for developers building intelligent assistants, automation tools, or any system that depends on fresh, precise web data.

items.title: PromptQL
items.description: Multiplayer AI that replaces Slack
items.summary_zh: PromptQL 是一款多用户协作AI工具，号称要取代Slack。它让团队成员可以在同一个AI对话中实时协作，共同查询数据、生成内容或解决问题。对于需要频繁沟通和共享AI结果的团队来说，PromptQL 将聊天与AI能力无缝融合，提升协作效率。
items.summary_en: PromptQL is a multiplayer AI chat platform designed to replace Slack for team collaboration. It allows multiple users to interact with the same AI in real-time, sharing queries, results, and context. This transforms team communication by embedding AI assistance directly into conversations, making it easier to solve problems collectively. It's particularly valuable for data-driven teams that need quick answers and collaborative analysis.

items.title: Teable 3.0
items.description: AI Spreadsheet for Business
items.summary_zh: Teable 3.0 将AI能力注入电子表格，打造面向企业的智能数据处理平台。它不仅能自动分析数据、生成图表，还能基于自然语言指令完成复杂运算。对于需要快速洞察数据的企业用户来说，Teable 让数据分析从专业操作变成日常对话。
items.summary_en: Teable 3.0 is an AI-powered spreadsheet designed for business users. It integrates intelligent data analysis, natural language querying, and automated chart generation directly into the familiar spreadsheet interface. This tool helps business professionals gain insights without needing advanced data skills, making data-driven decision making accessible to everyone in an organization.

items.title: PodcastorAI
items.description: Your AI twin hosts your video podcast
items.summary_zh: PodcastorAI 能创建你的AI数字分身，让它代替你主持视频播客。你只需提供素材，AI就能模拟你的声音、表情和风格，自动生成完整的播客节目。这对于忙碌的内容创作者或希望规模化生产播客的人来说，可以大幅节省录制时间，同时保持个人品牌一致性。
items.summary_en: PodcastorAI creates an AI twin that can host your video podcast on your behalf. By training on your voice, face, and style, the AI generates a full podcast episode with your digital avatar, saving hours of recording time. This is perfect for busy content creators or brands wanting to scale podcast production while maintaining a personal touch. It also enables creators to repurpose written content into engaging video podcasts automatically.

items.title: CrawlRaven
items.description: SEO Hub for GSC + GA4 + a 200-point crawl
items.summary_zh: CrawlRaven是一个一站式SEO中心，整合了Google Search Console和GA4数据，并提供200项网站健康度扫描。对于SEO从业者来说，它免去了在多个平台间切换的麻烦，将搜索排名数据、流量分析和页面审核统一在一个界面中。其爬虫功能会检查200个关键指标，帮助发现技术SEO问题。无论是优化关键词还是排查网站错误，CrawlRaven都能提供清晰的数据洞察，让SEO工作更加高效和系统化。
items.summary_en: CrawlRaven is an all-in-one SEO hub that integrates Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 data, along with a comprehensive 200-point website crawl. It eliminates the need to switch between multiple tools by consolidating search performance, traffic analytics, and site audits into a single dashboard. The crawl checks 200 critical health indicators, helping SEO professionals and site owners identify technical issues that impact rankings. With its unified view, CrawlRaven simplifies data analysis and makes it easier to optimize for search engines, saving time and improving overall site health.

items.title: Humalike x Hermes
items.description: Social intelligence plugin for Hermes Agent
items.summary_zh: Humalike 为 Hermes Agent 推出的社交智能插件，就像一个给智能代理装上“社交大脑”的工具。它能让 Agent 理解社交语境、分析人际关系，从而做出更人性化的交互。无论是客服、销售还是内部协作，这个插件都能让 AI 不再只是机械回复，而是有温度地沟通。适合那些已经在用 Hermes Agent 并希望提升用户体验的团队。
items.summary_en: Humalike's social intelligence plugin for Hermes Agent is like giving an AI agent a 'social brain'. It enables the agent to understand social context, analyze relationships, and interact more humanely. Whether for customer support, sales, or internal teamwork, this plugin transforms the agent from a mechanical responder into a warm communicator. Teams already using Hermes Agent and looking to elevate user experience will find great value here.

items.title: Migma AI
items.description: AI runs your email marketing. Better with every send.
items.summary_zh: Migma AI 是一个用人工智能驱动电子邮件营销的平台，它的独特之处在于每次发送都会学习并优化自己。从邮件内容到发送时机，AI 不断调整策略以提升打开率和转化率。你不再需要手动测试和猜测，系统会自动找到最佳方案。对于那些想要轻松管理邮件营销、又不擅长数据分析的中小企业主和营销人员来说，这简直是福音。
items.summary_en: Migma AI is an AI-driven email marketing platform that gets better with every send. It continuously learns from each campaign to optimize content, timing, and targeting, improving open rates and conversions automatically. You no longer need to manually A/B test or guess what works—the system finds the best strategy on its own. For small business owners and marketers who want effective email marketing without diving into data analysis, Migma AI is a gift.

items.title: Kastra
items.description: Runtime authorization for Claude, Cursor, Codex and OpenClaw
items.summary_zh: Kastra 是一款运行时授权管理工具，专为 Claude、Cursor、Codex 和 OpenClaw 等 AI 代码助手设计。它让团队能够精细控制这些工具在哪些代码库、目录或文件中可以执行操作，并实时审计每一次 AI 建议的访问权限。对于需要兼顾开发效率和代码安全的企业来说，Kastra 填补了AI辅助编程中“谁来授权、如何追踪”的关键空白。
items.summary_en: Kastra is a runtime authorization layer for AI coding assistants like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and OpenClaw. It gives teams granular control over which codebases, directories, or files these tools can access, and provides real-time audit trails for every AI-driven action. For organizations balancing developer productivity with code security, Kastra fills the critical gap of 'who authorizes what' in the age of AI-assisted programming.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: Codex 穷鬼大救星
items.description: 穷则思变，富则...算了，富哥就不用看这篇文章了！ 为了守护我们钱包，这套穷鬼工作流横空出世！ 欢迎来到 AI 黑心包工队！
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了一套名为“穷鬼工作流”的AI编程方案，旨在帮助预算有限的开发者利用Codex等工具低成本完成项目。作者以幽默自嘲的口吻，将这套方案比作“AI黑心包工队”，强调其核心价值是让手头拮据的程序员也能享受AI带来的效率提升，而不必购买昂贵的付费服务。对于个人开发者和小团队尤其实用。
items.summary_en: This article introduces a budget-friendly AI coding workflow called "Poor Guy Workflow," aimed at helping developers with limited funds leverage tools like Codex to complete projects at low cost. The author humorously dubs it an "AI shady contractor team," emphasizing that it allows coders on a tight budget to enjoy AI efficiency boosts without expensive subscriptions. It's especially practical for indie developers and small teams.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: 拓扑管网 3D 可视化大屏demo：科技感（地图 + 拓扑 + 3D 空间）

items.summary_zh: 这是一款极具科技感的3D数据大屏Demo，它在真实地理地图上叠加了供热管网的拓扑结构和三维空间管路，实现了“地图+拓扑+3D”融合的可视化效果。它专为炫酷视觉而设计，能帮助运维人员或管理者一目了然地掌握管网布局与运行状态，对于智慧城市和工业数字化场景十分有价值。
items.summary_en: This is a sci-fi styled 3D data dashboard demo that overlays heating network topology and spatial pipelines on a real geographic map, creating a combined map-topology-3D visualization. Designed for impressive visuals, it helps operators or managers grasp the entire network layout and status at a glance, making it valuable for smart city and industrial digitalization scenarios.

items.title: 停更的这一年，All In AI、陪媳妇生娃、还考了个研
items.description: 停更的这一年，All In AI、陪媳妇生娃、还考了个研 打开掘金 App，看了一眼自己的最近更新——停在了整整一年前。 不是不想写，是这一年确实被塞得太满了。如果非要用几个关键词来概括，那就是： A
items.summary_zh: 一位掘金作者停更一年后回归，分享了这段时间的密集经历：全力投入 AI 领域、陪伴妻子生娃、还抽空考了个研。文章以第一人称讲述了如何平衡工作、家庭与个人提升，展现了技术人在生活重大节点上的真实抉择。对面临类似境遇的读者来说，这是一个关于如何在巨大压力下仍坚持成长的真实故事。
items.summary_en: A Juejin author returns after a year-long hiatus, recounting a whirlwind period of diving headfirst into AI, supporting his wife through childbirth, and even squeezing in graduate school exams. Through first-person narration, he shares how he balanced career, family, and personal growth, offering a relatable and inspiring tale for developers navigating life’s major milestones while striving to keep improving.

items.title: 如何看待内存的涨价终于波及到了显卡，50 系显卡逐渐大面积缺货开始暴涨？
items.summary_zh: 内存涨价已传导至显卡领域，NVIDIA RTX 50系列显卡因显存成本上升、叠加AI与游戏需求旺盛，出现大面积缺货和价格暴涨。这暴露了供应链依赖单一内存厂商的风险，也让普通玩家和装机用户面临更大的预算压力。业内人士担忧，若内存持续高位，显卡价格短期内很难回落。
items.summary_en: The memory price hike has finally affected graphics cards: NVIDIA RTX 50 series GPUs are now suffering widespread shortages and sharp price increases due to rising VRAM costs combined with surging AI and gaming demand. This reveals the supply chain risk of relying on a few memory makers, and puts enormous pressure on ordinary PC builders and gamers. Industry insiders warn that if memory stays high, GPU prices are unlikely to drop anytime soon.

items.title: 如何评价 Anthropic 发布的 Claude Opus 5？
items.summary_zh: Anthropic推出的Claude Opus 5在推理、编码和多语言能力上均有显著提升，尤其在数学和科学基准测试中超越了许多竞品。它延续了Claude系列注重安全性的传统，同时大幅降低了幻觉率。对于需要高可靠性分析、复杂任务处理的开发者和企业用户而言，这是一款值得关注的强大模型。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 brings significant improvements in reasoning, coding, and multilingual capabilities, surpassing many rivals on math and science benchmarks. It maintains the series' strong safety focus while drastically reducing hallucinations. For developers and enterprise users who need reliable analysis and complex task handling, this is a powerful model worth following.

items.title: SpaceX 星舰第 13 次试飞，首次部署20 颗卫星，完美溅落后主体保持完整，此次发射有哪些看点？
items.summary_zh: SpaceX星舰在第十三次试飞中首次成功部署了20颗卫星，并且超重-星舰组合体的两级都实现了完美的溅落回收，主体保持完整。这标志着星舰向实用化迈进了一大步，验证了其运载能力、在轨部署能力和可重复使用性，为未来的大规模卫星组网和深空任务奠定了基础。
items.summary_en: SpaceX's Starship achieved a major milestone on its 13th test flight: it deployed 20 satellites for the first time, and both stages performed a perfect splashdown with the main structures intact. This proves the vehicle's payload capacity, on-orbit deployment capability, and reusability, paving the way for large-scale satellite constellations and future deep space missions.

items.title: 如何看待腾讯 317 万年终奖员工因泄密被辞退，「打入黑名单，永不录用」？大厂保密红线究竟有多严？
items.summary_zh: 一名腾讯员工因泄露公司内部信息（涉及317万年终奖细节）被辞退并列入行业黑名单，永不录用。这凸显了互联网大厂对保密红线零容忍的态度，泄密不仅会导致立即失业，还会影响整个职业生涯。该事件警示所有从业者：内部敏感信息绝不能外传，违者代价极高。
items.summary_en: A Tencent employee was fired and blacklisted permanently after leaking internal information about a 3.17 million yuan year-end bonus. This shows the zero-tolerance policy for confidentiality breaches at Big Tech companies. Leaking can cost not only your job but also your entire career in the industry. The case serves as a stark warning that sensitive internal information must never be disclosed, or the consequences will be severe.

items.title: 如何看微软联合发布的「开源权重模型对健康的 AI 生态系统至关重要」？
items.summary_zh: 微软联合多家机构发布声明，强调开源权重模型对构建健康AI生态系统至关重要。声明指出，开放模型权重能降低开发门槛，促进技术透明与社区协作，避免少数巨头垄断核心能力。同时它呼吁政策制定者支持开源路径，在监管与创新间取得平衡。这对AI开发者、研究者以及行业生态多样性都意义重大。
items.summary_en: Microsoft, together with several organizations, published a joint statement arguing that open-weight models are vital for a healthy AI ecosystem. By releasing model weights publicly, developers lower barriers to entry, foster transparency, and encourage community-driven innovation, preventing a handful of tech giants from hoarding core capabilities. The statement also urges policymakers to support open-source approaches, balancing regulation with innovation. This matters for AI researchers, startups, and anyone who cares about a diverse, competitive AI landscape.

items.title: 用 AI 润色英文论文会增加论文的 aigc 率吗?
items.summary_zh: 很多人担心用AI润色英文论文会提高AIGC检测率，但关键在于润色程度与工具选择。轻度语法修正和词汇替换通常不会被标记，而大段重写或风格统一化则容易被AI检测器识别。论文写作中，AI是辅助工具，保留自己的学术表达和逻辑脉络，同时合理使用润色功能，既能降低AIGC风险又能提升语言质量。
items.summary_en: Many worry that using AI to polish English papers will increase AIGC (AI-generated content) detection rates. The key lies in the extent of editing and the choice of tools. Light grammar fixes and vocabulary swaps usually go unnoticed, while heavy rewriting or style homogenization can trigger detectors. If you preserve your own academic voice and logical flow while using AI for targeted polish, you can improve language quality without raising red flags. It's all about working with AI, not handing over the pen.

items.title: 如何评价荣耀最新的 logo？为啥要在这个时间点更换 logo？
items.summary_zh: 荣耀近期更换品牌logo，新标识更简洁现代，去掉中文「荣耀」字样，仅保留英文「HONOR」并采用定制字体。此举正值荣耀独立三周年、定位高端全球化的关键节点。更换logo不仅是视觉升级，更是品牌重塑——适应国际市场竞争，强化科技与时尚感。对年轻用户和海外市场来说，新logo更简洁易记，传递了荣耀从华为剥离后独立发展的新魄力。
items.summary_en: Honor recently refreshed its logo, adopting a minimalist, modern design that drops the Chinese characters and uses a custom font for 'HONOR'. The timing coincides with the company's third anniversary of independence and its push into the global high-end market. The logo change isn't just about looks—it signals a strategic rebranding to appeal to international consumers and younger audiences, emphasizing technology and style. With a cleaner identity, Honor aims to strengthen its standalone presence and compete more effectively beyond its home market.

items.title: 小亏大赚，普通人的凸性投资完整路径
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了适合普通人的“凸性投资”策略，即通过承担有限的小亏损来追求大概率的大收益。它解释了凸性在投资中的含义，并提供了完整的操作路径。对于追求长期稳健回报、不愿承受重大损失的散户投资者来说，它提供了一种科学的风险管理思路，帮助他们在不确定的市场中实现“小亏大赚”。
items.summary_en: This article introduces the concept of 'convex investing' for ordinary people, a strategy where one accepts small, limited losses in exchange for the potential of large, asymmetric gains. It explains convexity in finance and outlines a complete investment pathway. Targeted at retail investors seeking steady long-term returns while avoiding catastrophic losses, it offers a disciplined risk management framework to achieve higher reward-to-risk ratios and navigate market uncertainty.

items.title: 梁文锋押注的方向，中国00后团队先交卷了，性能直逼Opus 4.8
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章报道了中国知名投资者梁文锋所押注的技术方向，由一支00后团队率先做出了成果，其性能接近业界顶尖的Opus 4.8。这展示了年轻团队的创新能力及中国在某个前沿科技领域的快速进展。对于关注AI和科技投资趋势的人，这是一个重要的信号：年轻创业者正在引领突破。
items.summary_en: A Chinese post-00s team has beaten expectations by delivering a product in a technology direction backed by prominent investor Liang Wenfeng, with performance rivaling the industry-leading Opus 4.8. This highlights the innovative power of China's youngest talent and rapid progress in cutting-edge tech. For AI and venture capital watchers, it signals a new wave where Gen Z entrepreneurs are driving breakthroughs and reshaping the competitive landscape.

items.title: 外骨骼救得了耐克吗？
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了外骨骼技术是否能帮助耐克公司扭转颓势。外骨骼作为一种可穿戴助力设备，可能被应用于运动训练或产品创新。它分析了耐克面临的挑战以及外骨骼技术带来的潜在机会。对于那些关注运动品牌转型和技术创新的人，这是一个有趣的案例，思考传统企业如何借助黑科技重塑竞争力。
items.summary_en: This article examines whether exoskeleton technology can rescue Nike from its recent struggles. Exoskeletons, wearable robotic suits that enhance human strength and endurance, could revolutionize athletic training or product design. The piece analyzes Nike's current business challenges and explores how embracing this emerging tech might offer a path to rejuvenation. It's a compelling case study for those interested in how legacy brands leverage cutting-edge innovation to reinvent themselves.

items.title: Kimi 叫停新订阅后，如何用上 K3
items.summary_zh: Kimi 在叫停新订阅后，用户如何继续使用 K3 成为焦点。K3 是 Kimi 推出的新一代 AI 模型，性能大幅提升，但因策略调整暂停了新用户订阅。现有用户仍可正常使用，而新用户可通过邀请码或等待官方重新开放来体验。这一变动反映了 AI 公司在资源分配和用户增长间的平衡难题，对关注大模型发展的用户来说，了解这些途径至关重要。
items.summary_en: After Kimi suspended new subscriptions, users are wondering how to access its latest model K3. Kimi K3 is a significant leap in AI performance, but the company has paused new sign-ups to manage resources. Existing users can still use it, and newcomers can seek invitation codes or wait for re-opening. This move highlights the tension between scaling user base and maintaining service quality in the AI industry, making it crucial for tech enthusiasts to understand the workarounds.

items.title: 一年暴涨100倍，AI最被低估的生意爆发了
items.summary_zh: AI 领域一个曾被严重低估的生意在过去一年暴涨了 100 倍，引发了行业震动。这个生意并非热门的模型训练，而是 AI 数据标注与合成数据服务。随着大模型对高质量、多样性数据的需求激增，数据标注公司从幕后走向台前，成为 AI 产业链上最赚钱的环节之一。对于投资者和从业者来说，这揭示了 AI 商业化中基础设施的重要性，以及下一个蓝海市场的所在。
items.summary_en: A once-underestimated AI business—data annotation and synthetic data services—has exploded 100-fold in value over the past year. As large language models demand ever more high-quality, diverse data, annotation companies have emerged from the shadows to become one of the most lucrative links in the AI chain. This boom underscores the critical role of data infrastructure in AI commercialization, signaling a blue ocean for investors and entrepreneurs looking beyond model training.

items.title: Kimi K3，已经撕裂了整个硅谷
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3 的发布在硅谷引发了巨大震动，甚至被形容为“撕裂了整个硅谷”。这款由中国团队开发的 AI 模型在多项基准测试中超越了 GPT-4 和 Claude 3，尤其在长文本处理和多模态理解上表现惊艳。硅谷的 AI 从业者开始重新审视中国大模型的竞争力，有些公司甚至调整了技术路线。K3 的出现不仅是一款产品的成功，更标志着全球 AI 格局的深刻变化。
items.summary_en: The release of Kimi K3 has sent shockwaves through Silicon Valley, with some saying it has torn the tech hub apart. This Chinese AI model outperforms GPT-4 and Claude 3 on key benchmarks, especially in long-context processing and multimodal understanding. Silicon Valley engineers are now re-evaluating China's AI capabilities, and some companies have already pivoted their strategies. K3 is not just a product milestone—it signals a fundamental shift in the global AI landscape.

items.title: 刚刚，Claude爆改语音，11种语言，就是没中文
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 刚刚为 Claude 推出了全新的语音功能，支持 11 种语言的自然对话，却独独缺少了中文。这一更新让 Claude 的交互体验大幅提升，用户可以用语音进行多轮对话、翻译和创作。但中文的缺失让国内用户感到失望，也引发了对 AI 语音技术本地化差异的讨论。对于多语言工作者和国际用户，这依然是一个强大的工具，但中文社区的缺席提醒我们，全球 AI 服务仍存在语言鸿沟。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has just launched a major voice upgrade for Claude, supporting natural conversations in 11 languages—but notably missing Chinese. The feature enables multi-turn dialogue, translation, and creative tasks via voice, greatly enhancing Claude's interactivity. While exciting for multilingual users globally, the omission of Chinese disappoints the vast Chinese-speaking community and highlights persistent language gaps in AI services. For now, it's a powerful tool for those who work in supported languages, but a reminder of uneven globalization in tech.

items.title: 可乐为什么卖不动了？
items.summary_zh: 可乐销量下滑并非偶然，背后是消费观念和市场竞争的深刻转变。一方面，健康意识崛起让含糖饮料备受质疑，无糖、低卡、功能饮料等替代品抢走了大量用户；另一方面，新消费品牌如元气森林、各类气泡水以更丰富的口味和营销手段分割市场。同时，可乐的传统渠道优势正在被便利店、电商和新零售模式削弱。对于快消行业从业者，这一趋势揭示了消费者向“健康+个性化”迁移的必然，传统巨头需要重新思考产品策略。
items.summary_en: The decline in cola sales is no accident—it reflects a fundamental shift in consumer preferences and market dynamics. Rising health consciousness has turned consumers away from sugary drinks toward zero-sugar, low-calorie, and functional alternatives. Meanwhile, challenger brands like Genki Forest and various sparkling waters are eroding cola's market share with innovative flavors and marketing. Additionally, traditional distribution advantages are fading as convenience stores, e-commerce, and new retail dominate. For the FMCG industry, this trend signals an inevitable pivot toward health and personalization, forcing legacy giants to rethink their strategies.

items.title: DeepSeek不是理想主义公司，它只是把现实服务于理想
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek这家公司看起来充满理想主义色彩，但创始人梁文锋坦言他们并非纯粹的理想主义公司，而是把现实作为服务理想的工具。他们注重技术落地和商业闭环，在追求AGI的同时也考虑如何让AI真正产生价值。这种务实与愿景结合的态度，或许正是中国AI公司走向成熟的关键。对于关注AI赛道的人来说，这篇文章揭示了理想与现实之间如何平衡的真谛。
items.summary_en: This article explores DeepSeek's philosophy, revealing that the company is not purely idealistic but rather uses practical, grounded approaches to serve its larger vision. Founder Liang Wenfeng emphasizes that they prioritize real-world application and sustainable business models while pursuing AGI. This pragmatic yet visionary mindset might be what Chinese AI companies need to mature. For anyone following the AI industry, it offers valuable insights into balancing lofty goals with commercial reality.

items.title: 利润暴增85倍，东方甄选的“去董宇辉化”赌局赢了
items.summary_zh: 东方甄选在经历与董宇辉的切割后，交出了一份惊人的成绩单：利润暴增85倍。这标志着他们大胆的“去董宇辉化”战略取得了决定性胜利。公司成功摆脱了对单一主播的依赖，通过强化自营品牌和供应链能力，建立了更加健康和可持续的商业模式。对于直播电商行业来说，这是一个重要的转折点——证明了即使没有超级头部主播，企业也能通过系统化运营实现爆发式增长。
items.summary_en: East Buy, the Chinese livestream e-commerce company, reported a staggering 85-fold profit surge after parting ways with its star host Dong Yuhui. This proves that their bold 'de-Dong Yuhui-ization' gamble paid off. By reducing reliance on a single celebrity host and focusing on proprietary brands and supply chain, the company built a healthier, more sustainable model. For the livestream commerce industry, this case signals a turning point: systematic operations can win even without a top influencer.

父子不内斗、女婿不逼宫，浙商二代们为啥不爱接班了？
